subject:
POC Kickoff 




Redwood trial & next steps

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 15:10:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Discovery - POC next steps / Redwood POC plan

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for the time today - great to hear about Acme's search & support use cases.

Recap & proposed next steps:
- Objective: validate Redwood for low-latency semantic search over product docs and a chat assistant for support triage.
- Success criteria: <10% false positive rate on rerank test set, median inference latency <200ms for 512 tokens, and first-week trial traffic of ~5k tokens/day.
- Recommended starter config: gpt-small-quant (balanced cost/latency) on a dedicated pool for the POC.
- POC Kickoff tasks (we can help run these):
  1) Create Redwood org + invite engineers (we can invite via email)
  2) Share a small dataset (500 docs) and sample prompts
  3) Whitelist Acme IPs / or set up VPC peering (optional for this POC)
  4) We enable a 2-week trial quota and a dashboard for usage

I've attached a one-page runbook (redwood_poc_runbook.pdf) and a mutual action plan template.

Suggested times for a 30-min kickoff next week:
- Tue 2026-10-05 10:00am PT
- Wed 2026-10-06 2:00pm PT

If those don't work, happy to propose others. Happy to run the initial org setup if you send a list of invitees.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
